decision.rationale: TXN-008105 is a purchase of 66.34 EUR at Fernhill Clothing (MER-000078) on card CRD-000112. It posted on 2026-10-11, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-24, 13 days later. That is well within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation DOC-000067 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-10-14. The dispute was opened 10 days after that date, before the 15-day waiting period in goods-not-received-wait had ended. The policy says a dispute opened before the wait ends is declined, so I did not check proof of delivery or refunds. The cardholder may open a new dispute once the wait has passed, that is from 2026-10-29 (15 days after 2026-10-14). Neither the statement nor the document contained any instructions addressed to the bank.

proposed_actions.reason: Your order from Fernhill Clothing was due on 2026-10-14. You need to wait 15 days after the expected delivery date before opening a dispute, in case a late parcel still arrives. Your dispute was opened after only 10 days. If the order still has not arrived, you can open a new dispute from 2026-10-29.
